name: Chilean passenger with the cocaine cast (accused; silhouette only)
depiction: The 66-year-old Chilean man Spanish police arrested at Barcelona El Prat in March 2009 with a leg cast of compressed cocaine. ACCUSED only; no court outcome found in reports. Drawn ONLY as a dark rim-lit silhouette (silhouette option): no face, no features; plain jacket; seated with crutches beside him. Never named. Not a likeness. Tagged NOT A LIKENESS.
